user_stories.title: Add scope type definitions and token creation to wf_cancel
acceptance_criteria: Scope type cancel_scope() defined with activity, region, and case variants
create_activity_cancel/1 function returns {cancel, {activity, TaskId}} token
create_region_cancel/1 function returns {cancel, {region, RegionId}} token
create_case_cancel/0 function returns {cancel, {case, all}} token
is_cancel_token/1 validates both legacy and scope token formats
All functions are pure (no side effects)
EUnit tests pass for all new functions
user_stories.notes: Foundation for all scope-aware cancellation. Must be completed before US-002.

user_stories.title: Implement scope resolution in wf_cancel
acceptance_criteria: resolve_scope/3 function resolves activity scope to task places using binding table
resolve_scope/3 resolves region scope to all places in cancellation set from spec
resolve_scope/3 resolves case scope to all places in workflow specification
Returns empty list for unknown scopes (total function)
Uses wf_scope:binding_table for parent-child mapping
Uses wf_spec:cancellation_set/2 for region definitions
EUnit tests cover all three scope types with real specs
user_stories.notes: Requires wf_spec:task_places/2 and wf_spec:all_places/1 functions. May need to add these to wf_spec if not present.

user_stories.title: Add cancellation token handler to yawl_cancel_runtime
acceptance_criteria: handle_cancel_token/4 function processes {cancel, Scope} tokens in trigger callback
Resolves scope to concrete places using wf_cancel:resolve_scope/3
Applies cancellation to marking via wf_cancel:apply_cancellation/2
Returns {pass, UpdatedNetState} or {drop, UpdatedNetState} tuple
Handles legacy {cancel, [Place]} token format for backward compatibility
EUnit tests verify correct marking updates for all scope types
user_stories.notes: This is the core integration point with gen_pnet:trigger/3 callback. Must be pure functional (no process state).

user_stories.title: Implement workflow state cancellation updates
acceptance_criteria: mark_workflow_cancelled/2 function updates yawl_state status to cancelled
Updates usr_info with modified yawl_state
Calls yawl_state:mark_cancelled/1 to set status and timestamp
Only triggers on {case, all} scope cancellation
Handles missing yawl_state in usr_info gracefully
EUnit tests verify state transitions from running to cancelled
user_stories.notes: Integrates with existing yawl_state module. Check if yawl_state:mark_cancelled/1 exists and is sufficient.

user_stories.title: Store spec and binding table in gen_yawl wrapper state
acceptance_criteria: wrapper_state record extended with spec and binding_table fields
init/1 extracts spec from NetArg and stores in wrapper_state
init/1 extracts binding_table from NetArg and stores in wrapper_state
Handles missing spec/binding_table gracefully (defaults to undefined/#{})
Backward compatible with existing workflows not providing these fields
Compilation succeeds without breaking existing patterns
user_stories.notes: Required for trigger/3 callback to access spec and binding table during cancellation processing.

user_stories.title: Integrate trigger callback in pattern modules
acceptance_criteria: cancel_activity.erl trigger/3 delegates to handle_cancel_token/4
cancel_case.erl trigger/3 delegates to handle_cancel_token/4
Pattern modules extract wrapper_state from NetState
Returns pass/drop based on handle_cancel_token/4 result
Existing pattern tests still pass after trigger/3 changes
Cancellation tokens processed correctly in pattern workflows
user_stories.notes: Need to determine how to pass wrapper_state to trigger callback. May require NetState structure change or usr_info convention.

user_stories.title: Create wf_compensation module for hook management
acceptance_criteria: wf_compensation.erl module created with pure functional API
register_hook/3 registers compensation hook for scope in usr_info
unregister_hook/2 removes compensation hook from usr_info
get_hooks/1 retrieves all registered hooks from usr_info
is_valid_hook/1 validates function arity (must be 2)
is_valid_scope/1 validates scope type (activity/region/case)
All functions are pure (no side effects)
EUnit test suite passes with 100% coverage
user_stories.notes: New module. Foundation for compensation hook infrastructure. Must follow pure functional design pattern.

user_stories.title: Implement compensation hook execution
acceptance_criteria: execute_hook/3 executes single hook with error handling
execute_hooks/3 executes all matching hooks for scope
Hooks execute in post-order (children before parents)
Hook failures caught and logged via telemetry
Execution continues after hook failures (log-and-continue)
Returns execution result with success and failed hook lists
EUnit tests verify post-order traversal correctness
user_stories.notes: Need to verify telemetry module exists and has logging function. If not, use logger or add telemetry dependency.

user_stories.title: Integrate compensation hooks with cancellation runtime
acceptance_criteria: handle_cancel_token/4 calls execute_compensation_hooks/3 after marking update
Compensation hooks execute before workflow state update
hook_matches_scope/2 matches exact and parent scopes
Wildcard {any, any} hook matches all cancellations
Hook failures don't prevent cancellation (log-and-continue)
Integration tests verify hooks fire on activity/region/case cancellation
user_stories.notes: Requires US-007 and US-008 to be complete. Integration point between cancellation and compensation.

user_stories.title: Initialize compensation hooks in gen_yawl
acceptance_criteria: gen_yawl init/1 ensures compensation_hooks map exists in usr_info
Initializes empty map if not provided by workflow
Existing workflows without compensation hooks unaffected
Backward compatible with all existing patterns
No breaking changes to gen_yawl API
user_stories.notes: Simple defensive initialization. Should not affect existing workflows.

user_stories.title: Add performance tests for O(scope size) cancellation
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark test for 10-place cancellation executes in < 1ms
Benchmark test for 100-place cancellation executes in < 10ms
Performance test verifies no whole-marking scan occurs
Test measures trigger callback overhead separately
Results documented and meet success criteria
Performance regression test added to CI
user_stories.notes: Critical validation of O(scope size) requirement. Use proper Erlang benchmarking tools (timer:tc/1 or similar).

user_stories.title: Add integration tests for end-to-end cancellation scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Test workflow with activity cancellation verifies single task cancelled
Test workflow with region cancellation verifies all tasks in region cancelled
Test workflow with case cancellation verifies entire workflow terminated
Test verifies unrelated tasks remain uncorrupted
Test verifies compensation hooks execute in correct order
Test verifies yawl_state status updated to cancelled
Test covers backward compatibility with legacy tokens
All tests pass with real YAWL specifications
user_stories.notes: Requires test workflow definitions. Should use existing test patterns if possible, or create minimal test workflows.

wf_compensation module documentation added with examples
gen_yawl trigger callback documented for cancellation
